tested_ratio_range: Specify the approved portrait/landscape ratio range
sizing_policy: State fixed areas, flexible areas, uniform scaling, gaps and small-screen fallback

rule_fields.id: Stable source-node ID or new group ID
rule_fields.parent: Owning group ID; empty for Canvas root

case_fields.insets: Simulated safe-area insets [left,top,right,bottom]; never global device constants
